ng-custom-events.name: Longtap event
ng-custom-events.description: Fires for a long press or context-menu gesture. Uses the native `contextmenu` event where available and provides an iOS-compatible fallback.

ng-custom-events.name: Resize event
ng-custom-events.description: Fires when the element dimensions change, using `ResizeObserver` under the hood.

ng-custom-events.name: Custom modifiers for declarative events handling

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: capture
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Listens for the event during the capture phase instead of the bubbling phase.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: once
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Removes the event listener automatically after the first invocation.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: passive
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Registers a passive event listener, allowing the browser to optimize scrolling and other input handling.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: prevent
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Calls `event.preventDefault()` before invoking the event handler.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: self
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Invokes the handler only when the event originated from the element itself, ignoring bubbled events from descendants.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: silent
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Legacy alias for `zoneless`. Runs the event handler outside Angular's `NgZone` to avoid triggering change detection.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: zoneless
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Runs the event handler outside Angular's `NgZone` to avoid triggering change detection.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: stop
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Calls `event.stopPropagation()` before invoking the event handler.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: debounce~<delay>ms
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Invokes the handler after events stop arriving for the specified delay in milliseconds. Example: `click.debounce~300ms`.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: debounce~<delay>s
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Invokes the handler after events stop arriving for the specified delay in seconds. Example: `click.debounce~2s`.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: throttle~<delay>ms
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Invokes the handler at most once per specified interval in milliseconds. Example: `click.throttle~300ms`.

ng-event-plugins-modifiers.name: throttle~<delay>s
ng-event-plugins-modifiers.description: Invokes the handler at most once per specified interval in seconds. Example: `click.throttle~2s`.
